fish_table.title: 鱼表格
fish_table.available_fact: 16 base fish rows with names, eating notes, sacrifice notes, regions, weight ranges, strength coefficient, stamina, album text, chum attribute, buff, duration, and experience columns.
fish_table.blocking_fact: Preference bait and rarity columns are empty, and the sheet does not directly provide UE BodyClass, BitePersonalityId, FightPersonalityId, or fish body class mapping.

fish_book.title: 鱼
fish_book.available_fact: The fish book declares the fish table as the fish-data SSOT and defines the intended fields: distribution, chum axis, weight axis, bait preference, buff, and experience.
fish_book.blocking_fact: The book defines structure and ownership, not complete per-fish UE asset values.

fish_owner_decision_sync.title: 裁决同步 · 鱼／营地／UI 与交互（张佳）
fish_owner_decision_sync.available_fact: The owner-sync page assigns the fish book and fish table to Zhang Jia and names the fish-table completion work as the urgent delivery dependency.
fish_owner_decision_sync.blocking_fact: It explicitly lists six pending columns: preference bait, rarity, diet, outward segment length, rest segment length, and movement speed coefficient. Its older note about three missing toxic-fish base rows appears superseded by the current fish table revision, but the six-column blocker remains.

fish_behavior_doc.title: 鱼的行为
fish_behavior_doc.available_fact: The behavior plan defines diet, outward segment length, rest segment length, speed coefficient, water-depth pressure, dying struggle, line-length rhythm, and giant-fish exception semantics.
fish_behavior_doc.blocking_fact: The document status is complete initial draft pending owner review; it is an input to the fish table, not a completed per-fish mapping or UE bite/fight asset set.

bait_table.title: 窝料/饵
bait_table.available_fact: Chum and bait candidate tables exist.
bait_table.blocking_fact: Bait sheet says target fish are illustrative and authoritative preference data must come from the fish table preference column.

eating_effect_doc.title: 吃鱼效果
eating_effect_doc.available_fact: Effect families, yellow stamina, poison, no-effect fish, giant sacrifice blessing, and reconciliation notes are documented.
eating_effect_doc.blocking_fact: The document says per-fish effect assignment is read from the fish table; several reconciliation notes remain relevant for formal data.

art_resource_sheet.title: 临时美术资源表格
art_resource_sheet.available_fact: Fish art resource categories exist, including fish, fish animation, quality/size variants, and fish shadow categories.
art_resource_sheet.blocking_fact: The fish art sheet is category-level only and does not provide per-fish UE class or model mapping.

asset_readiness_rule: Do not generate or switch runtime config to formal fish, bite, or fight assets until this package is updated as ready with authoritative per-fish mappings and Config/DefaultGame.ini no longer references DA_Fish_Test01, DA_Bite_Test01, or DA_Fight_Test01.
